Every selected declaration was successfully probed against the pinned Mathlib; I compared its full signature and source context, including the extended-scale nonempty-guard formula, nonnegative exponents in M002–M005, the finite-dimensional real normed-space premises, RCLike finrank generality, countable and a.e.-measurable premises for M014, measurable-set premises for M015, boundedness and order-bornology in M017/M018, and pseudo extended metric generality in M021. D001's general coordinate-space binders are declared; D010 is the exact basis header's coordinate concatenation. These definitions are total or have conditions explicitly imposed at use, and have no unproved construction guards. All non-H nodes are in P's backward closure; each of N004,N005,N101–N106,P has exactly one displayed producer; the graph is acyclic. B101–B106 are proved internally, never imported as E. Structural validation of candidate 6 and this same-author inspection do not constitute independent Audit A.
